gap2_emailTerminologyAndComplianceBounda.finding: MEDIUM — Existing behavioral email validation tests exist, but there is no direct regression test locking the evidence/terminology boundary that the implementation performs conservative bounded email validation and DOES NOT claim full RFC 5322 compliance.
gap2_emailTerminologyAndComplianceBounda.resolution: Added focused regression test '21b. locks conservative email-validation terminology and forbids full RFC 5322 compliance claims' in tests/security/phaseA12B2C5U33BProductionOperationalAuth.test.ts locking evidence contract, markdown terminology, worker source constraints, and implementation character-length semantics.
gap2_emailTerminologyAndComplianceBounda.testDescription: 21b. locks conservative email-validation terminology and forbids full RFC 5322 compliance claims

regressionTestDetails.testName: 21b. locks conservative email-validation terminology and forbids full RFC 5322 compliance claims
assertions: Independently loads execution/a12b2c5u33b_production_operational_authentication_foundation.json and asserts emailSyntaxRFC5322Enforced === false
Asserts maxEmailLengthBytes is strictly absent from cryptographicPolicy and raw JSON
Inspects execution/a12b2c5u33b_production_operational_authentication_foundation.md to ensure conservative bounded terminology is documented and full RFC 5322 compliance is not claimed
Inspects worker/auth/cloudflareAccessOperationalAuth.ts source comments and code to verify conservative bounded operational email syntax (<= 320 chars) and absence of RFC 5322 claims
Binds to actual isValidEmail implementation: verifies 320-char email is valid, 321-char email is rejected
Binds to actual isValidEmail implementation: verifies exotic RFC 5322 forms (quoted local parts, comments, domain literals) are rejected
Binds to verifyCloudflareAccessIdentity JWT verification pipeline: 320-char succeeds, 321-char fails with EMAIL_REQUIRED, RFC quoted forms fail with EMAIL_REQUIRED
regressionTestDetails.explicitNonClaimOfRFC5322: VELNAR does not claim, enforce, or implement full RFC 5322 email syntax compliance. It implements conservative bounded operational email syntax validation with a 320-character JavaScript string length limit.
